title: Welcome to History Pros
sentences: Every day, three true stories from history.
Plagues, sieges, witch trials, and the people who lived through them.
Every story is checked against real historical sources.
And every Wednesday, a full documentary on YouTube.
On Monday, we begin with the Black Death, and the ships that brought it to Europe.
Follow History Pros, so you don't miss it.
